laws.rule: Mountain gorilla tracking permit (Volcanoes National Park): foreigners USD 1,500 (about A$2,131, RBA rate of 30 October 2026). Minimum age 15. Report to the park's visitor centre at 7 am. Documents are checked at the gate and false or erroneous applications are refused entry even if paid.
laws.heading: Mountain Gorilla Tracking

laws.rule: Volcanoes National Park gorilla tracking: minimum age 15; eight permits per troop per day; encounters have a strict one-hour maximum. Visitors gather at Kinigi park headquarters at 07:00 for allocation and briefing. Advance booking is highly recommended, not rewritten as an absolute mandatory-online-booking rule. Permits do not establish access to unrelated community ceremonies.
